name: Fynn, the Fangbearer (mono-green poison, Bracket 2)
notes:
DeckCheck scan of https://deckcheck.co/app/decklist/8quo9xQIP1gg, CRISPI 4.63, Bracket 2. Numbers copied from the CRISPI panel, not inferred. Commander taken from DeckCheck's own Bracket 1/2 metas. The corpus's first mono-green deck and its first Bracket 2 deck with a real scan rather than a rubric anchor - it is the control for whether the three precon anchors are set correctly.

CONSISTENCY 4 - "operates without specific tutors and relies on thirty-seven lands alongside sixteen cantrips and cycling effects. High density of redundant low-cost deathtouch creatures provides reliable early-game starts despite limited card draw."

RESILIENCE 3 - "nine targeted protection spells and four recursion cards safeguard key threats against spot removal. However, the lack of mass protection effects leaves the board vulnerable to sweeping board wipes."

INTERACTION 6 - "eighteen interactive pieces including eleven instant-speed fight, bite, and removal spells. These cards leverage deathtouch creatures as efficient removal."

SPEED 5.5 - band table maps 5.5 to win turns 6-7. "Attacks for two poison on turn two, four on turn three, eliminates the first opponent by turn four with six more poison. Remaining opponents reach ten poison by turns six to seven. The main bottleneck is navigating the combat step across three separate life totals without extra combat steps." Note this is a POISON clock, not damage - a good test of whether our goldfish models the ten-poison threshold.
